name: n4_list_schedule_kinds
description: Which kinds of schedule a station can hold and how each works, so no type name has to be known (reads no station, needs no session). schedule_kinds: boolean, numeric, enum, string (weekly schedules with special events: out follows the weekly time ranges, special events override them, a default output fills the rest), calendar (a list of days other schedules reference) and trigger (fires a topic at times of day on chosen days); each with its station type, value_type, the plain value it takes, default_output, which parts it has (weekly, special_events, dates, times), purpose, behaviour and what its out is usually linked to (by convention a writable's in16). event_kinds: date, date_range, week_and_day, custom and reference (the days of a calendar), each with its type, purpose, whether a calendar can hold it (in_calendar) and its fields with their allowed values. Also priority (top special event first), cleanup (passed date and date-range events are deleted by the station) and export_import (the station types that copy schedules between stations; no tool here).
